text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
My shoes are sopping wet too, how'm I 
gonna dry 'em...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"The forecast said it'd be sunny, though. 
Don't go getting in a bad mood out of 
nowhere~..."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Man, I really hate the rain. It just makes 
your body and mind feel all damp and 
gloomy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Soaked by the rain, Lucky Lilac fell into 
a gloomy mood.
